resources.string: A comic reader for Android tablets and phones, inspired by Panels. Free software, made to feel like reading a real comic book.

Under about 15 MB/s the limit is usually the Wi-Fi: check that this device is on the 5 GHz (or 6 GHz) network and close to the router.
Reading state and settings saved on the NAS by themselves.
Books can now be read as a real book in a place: cover that opens, page edges that grow as you read, the curve of the paper and pages that turn under your finger. Turn it on with 3D in the reader.
Seven page colours, fonts made for reading (Literata, Bitter, Atkinson Hyperlegible, OpenDyslexic) or your own, size, spacing, margins, justified text and columns.
Like on a Kindle, the bottom line tells how long until the end of the chapter or the book, learned from how fast you read. Tap it to switch to page or percentage.
Highlight in four colours, add notes and share them as Markdown, bookmarks, search the whole book, look up words, and listen with a sleep timer.

EPUB, Kindle files without DRM (MOBI, AZW3), FB2 and TXT open in Fwip. With comics and books together, a switch at the top of the library shows one or the other, and books can stand on a shelf by their spines.
A small clock and battery on the page, and Do Not Disturb while reading.
Comics can be read as a 3D book in the same places, with the cover opening and pages curling. Turn it on in the reader\'s settings.
The cover of what you are reading while the tablet charges.
Drag, share or open with Fwip
Drop comics onto the app in split screen, or share them to it from other apps.
When a new version is out, Update downloads and installs it right in Fwip, no browser needed. The first time, Android asks you to allow it.
Pages in 16 greys or soft colour on matte paper, instant page turns and an optional blink.
Bluetooth page turners, arrows, space and page keys turn pages.
Light that goes below the screen\'s minimum, warm light on a schedule and light that follows the room.
Book pages now curl like paper by default, even without the 3D book. Instant, slide and scroll are still in Aa.
A desk, a library, by the fire, mountains, a park, a rainy window, a beach at sunset or a starry night, each drawn or as a photo, with fire, leaves, rain and stars moving, and their own sound.
Grouped, with search, a summary of each group, reset buttons and two columns on the tablet.
